rationale:
Positives: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name + zip, looked up the user and orders with read-only tools, identified the correct laptop order (#W3730488) and the wristwatch in another pending order (#W9810810), checked product variants, and selected variants that matched the user’s requested specs. The price differences were plausibly handled via the specified gift card payment method. When the address update failed due to order status, the agent offered a human handoff, which aligns with policy when tooling cannot complete the request.

Policy breaches / outcome issues:
- The agent performed order-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation. This occurred for both the laptop modification (item swap in #W3730488) and the wristwatch modification (item swap in #W9810810). The policy requires explicit confirmation before any write.
- The agent also attempted to update the shipping address without explicit confirmation after proposing to do so.
- The agent could not complete the requested shipping address update. They attributed the inability to a status change after modification; while plausible given the tool error (“non-pending order cannot be modified”), the agent had already made changes without confirmation and did not provide a status readout before concluding.

Given the unconfirmed writes and incomplete fulfillment of the user’s request to update the address, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
